reference: The Utica branch: Karen tells the camera she is 'the regional manager of Dunder-Mifflin Utica branch' in Branch Wars (S4E6). Premise is true: in The Job (S3E23) Jim leaves the corporate interview and goes back to Pam; Karen's line in S4E6 refers to her boyfriend being 'in love with somebody else'.

evidence.line: Karen: I am the regional manager of Dunder-Mifflin Utica branch. Turns out it's a pretty easy gig when your boss isn't an idiot and your boyfriend's not in love with somebody else.
Michael: ...because our old friend Karen from Utica is going to give him more money to work there.

caveats: Karen's actual move/breakup with Jim happens largely off-screen between S3E23 and S4E1; the transcripts only show the result (S4E6).
question: Karen left Scranton after Jim chose Pam. Which branch did she go on to manage?
